audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Sylas levels 1 and 2 and then read 'Skill' for every remaining row, including the two item rows the prose says he wins.
audit.why: The packet chart and the already-audited mirror (mordekaiser__sylas) both read Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Mordekaiser / Sylas / Sylas. Mordekaiser out-trades a melee mage in the shield-and-pull phase; Sylas takes over on items, which is where the 54.67% comes from.
audit.corrected: All seven rows aligned to the packet chart in matched phases[].side + win[] pairs, with ratings moved to match and the three contradicting why lines rewritten.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly ordered: his level 2-3 shield/pull phase, his level 6 Realm of Death, Sylas's Riftmaker, and two-item Hijack. Only the rating column disagreed with them.
audit.corrected: phases ratings adjusted so the first-item and 2+ item rows read as Sylas spikes rather than 4/10 losses.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] calls the pull 'E Obliterate'; several fields call the shield 'W Iron Man'; three fields say Abduct stuns.
audit.why: Obliterate is the Q (675 range, 8/7/6/5/4s, bonus damage on a single target); the pull is Death's Grasp (E, 700 range, 16/14/12/10/8s); the shield is Indestructible (W, 12-8s, stores damage and can be consumed to heal). Sylas's Abduct recast pulls him to the enemy and does not stun — the mirror audit states the same.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns used; the stun claims replaced with what Abduct actually does, which matters because it drags Sylas into exactly the isolation Obliterate wants.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the content layer schedules Grievous Wounds against Indestructible.
audit.why: The missingInteractions entry flags exactly this: Indestructible's stored damage can be consumed as a heal, so the extended trades this matchup is built on are decided by anti-heal timing.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal moved into wants.you[1] alongside the Riftmaker build order.

edits.before: W online — the burst-heal turns even trades into wins. Take the extended trade only when his answer is down.
edits.after: Kingslayer heals, but Obliterate costs him no mana on an 8s cooldown and Indestructible banks whatever you deal.

edits.before: Full kit: E2 chain into Q-W-AA is a real chunk, and E1's shield eats the counter-trade. Trade in full rotations.
edits.after: Death's Grasp drags you in from 700 and Obliterate hits far harder on a lone target — stay out of that circle.

edits.before: Hijack online — you now own a copy of Mordekaiser's ultimate. The all-in math and every 2v2 swing your way.
edits.after: Realm of Death takes the duel somewhere your jungler cannot reach and steals your stats — his six beats yours.

edits.before: Engaging with both E charges spent — no shield, no stun, and you're a melee mage standing in the open.
edits.after: Engaging with both E charges spent — Abduct only pulls you in, and a melee mage has no exit without it.

edits.before: Engaging with both E charges spent — no shield, no stun, and you're a melee mage standing in the open.
edits.after: Abduct does not stun — it pulls you to him, which is exactly the isolation Obliterate is paid for.

edits.before: Mordekaiser spends Realm of Death early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Realm of Death costs him 100-140 seconds — once he spends it, the next two minutes are yours.

edits.before: Land E Obliterate pull to trigger Q isolated bonus and slam you for full damage
edits.after: Land Death's Grasp (E) to drag you in, then Obliterate (Q) for its solo bonus

edits.before: Stack W Iron Man shield by trading repeatedly so he wins extended brawls with increasing shield buffer
edits.after: Bank Indestructible (W) by trading repeatedly, then eat it for the heal that wins the extended brawl

edits.before: Hook him with E Abduct when his W shield is already depleted, then unload W Kingslayer while he is staggered for maximum missing-HP damage
edits.after: Abduct onto him only once Indestructible is spent or eaten, then Kingslayer immediately for the missing-HP damage before he rebuilds it

edits.before: Build Riftmaker first so your W heals compound over extended trades and negate his Q slam poke
edits.after: Build Riftmaker, then Grievous Wounds — Indestructible's heal is what wins him the extended trades

edits.before: With two items your Hijacked Realm of Death hits harder than his own version because it scales off your AP and Ability Haste rather than his, and your Riftmaker healing means you survive the opening exchanges that used to kill you at six. Force the all-in with E Abduct to stun him and open with W Kingslayer immediately — the missing-health scaling on W deletes his Iron Man shield buffer before he can rebuild it. In teamfights, stealing his R lets you exile their frontline carry while he sits useless without his ultimate, which is the real reason this matchup is net positive for you despite a rough laning phase.
